name: Feral Swashbuckler
body:
You can use your natural weapons as lethal fencing swords.

Prerequisite Finesse training class feature.

Benefit Choose one of your natural weapons. The selected natural weapon counts as a light piercing weapon for the purposes of swashbuckler class features and of feats and abilities that have these features as prerequisites.

This feat may be selected more than once; every time it applies to a different natural weapon.

Normal Swashbuckler class abilities such as precise strike don’t apply to natural weapons.
